name: FNaF: Support Requested
desc:
⚠️ FNaF : SR is a discontinued project and will NOT be updated under any circumstances. If you wish to follow my future projects and you are over 13, join the communications server.

🌟This game is a Roblox adaptation of Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's VR : Help Wanted'. All rights are reserved to Scott Cawthon and Steel Wool Studios🌟

👤Play solo in the many 'games' Fazbear Entertainment has to offer!

👥Play with your friends in the multiplayer experiences that showcases you posing as your favorite animatronic killers!

Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for the horror you may experience 😰
